baseline_inputs.csv.forty_f: official 40 time, z-scored within Combine class and position, missing set to 0 (the mean)
baseline_inputs.csv.combine_weight_f: Combine weight, z within position and class, missing = 0
baseline_inputs.csv.ngs_athleticism_score_f: NGS athleticism score, z within position and class, missing = 0
baseline_inputs.csv.BG: Break G score, z units (shrunk mean of drill-x-year z-scores)
baseline_inputs.csv.heldout_forecast_in: no-tracking forecast for this receiver, fitted on the other two classes, inches

pairs_inputs.csv.s1: first season of the pair (fold label: 2023 -> 2023/24, 2024 -> 2024/25)
pairs_inputs.csv.y1s: season-1 SOE shrunk by routes (empirical Bayes), yd
pairs_inputs.csv.f_m0: held-out pick-and-routes forecast (fitted on the other season pair), yd
pairs_inputs.csv.f_m1: held-out forecast with y1s added, yd

speed_inputs.csv.forty_std: official 40, z within position and class
speed_inputs.csv.vtop_full: NFL top speed: 90th pct of per-snap max over the full sampled play, yd/s (8+ snaps)
speed_inputs.csv.vtop_break: same, snap-to-throw frames of breaking snaps only (8+ snaps), yd/s
